name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source AI design workspace for generating prototypes, websites, dashboards and slides with your own model provider keys.

alerts.message: The browser asks for credentials on first visit: sign in with the username open-design and the generated OD_API_TOKEN value from the environment variables as the password.
The image bundles no agent CLIs. Add an API key for a model provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Azure or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) in the settings before generating designs.
Connectors such as Composio and GitHub only accept requests from the container itself, so they cannot be set up through the public domain.
